A resistance of 40 ohm and an inductance are connected in series in a 50 cycles/second ac circuit. The impedance of this combination is very nearly

(A) 30 ohm
(B) 40 ohm
(C) 50 ohm
(D) 60 ohm

STORED ANSWER KEY: "C"

STORED SOLUTION:
Z = √(R^2 + (2πvL)^2) = √((40)^2 + 4π^2×(50)^2×(95.5×10^(− 3))^2) = 50ohm
